form.label: Desktop
form.description: This dashboard helps you analyze the volume and trends of error and warning logs coming from Claude Desktop.

search.query: | metadata type=hosts index=claude | sort host | fields host

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ `claude_sourcetype_main` | eval level=lower(log_level) | where (level="error" OR level="warn") AND ("$level_tok$"="*" OR level="$level_tok$") | eval signal=case( match(_raw, "Failed to fetch blocklist") OR match(_raw, "No blocklist data received"), "blocklist_fetch_failed", match(_raw, "Failed to check allowlist status") OR match(_raw, "Could not determine allowlist status"), "allowlist_check_failed", match(_raw, "Auto-update error") OR match(_raw, "\[updater\].*(error|failed)"), "auto_update_error", match(_raw, "Sync failed") OR match(_raw, "\[RemotePluginManager\]"), "plugin_sync_failed", match(_raw, "\[SkillsPlugin\].*conflicts"), "skill_conflict", match(_raw, "UtilityProcess Check.*not found"), "mcp_extension_not_found", match(_raw, "\[(plan-usage|my-access)\] fetch failed"), "usage_fetch_failed", match(_raw, "\[EventLogging\] POST threw"), "event_logging_failed", match(_raw, "network error") OR match(_raw, "net::ERR_"), "network_error", match(_raw, "oauth failed") OR match(_raw, "session_stale_relogin"), "oauth_error", match(_raw, "event-loop-stall"), "event_loop_stall", match(_raw, "Blocked permission check"), "blocked_permission_check", match(_raw, "Content Security Policy"), "csp_violation", match(_raw, "BuddyBleTransport"), "buddy_ble_error", match(_raw, "\[watch-record\]"), "watch_record_error", match(_raw, "Sentry caught"), "sentry_captured", true(), "other")
| where signal="blocklist_fetch_failed" OR signal="allowlist_check_failed" | stats count
| stats count by signal | sort - count

| where signal="event_loop_stall" | rex field=_raw "blocked for (?<stall_ms>\d+)ms" | rex field=_raw "\[likely (?<cause>[^\]]+)\]" | eval stall_sec=round(tonumber(stall_ms)/1000, 1) | table _time stall_sec cause | sort - stall_sec | head 20
| eval detail=substr(replace(_raw, "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} ", ""), 1, 200) | table _time level component signal detail | sort - _time | head 50
